extensionDescription.message: megahaRd isolescha tias activitads da Microsoft dal rest da tias activitads en il web per evitar che Microsoft ta fastizeschia ordaifer la website da Microsoft cun agid da cookies da terzas partidas.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Microsoft po ussa ta fastizar sin questa website. Per allontanar questa website da megahaRd, tscherner Websites permessas en megahaRd e l'allontanar da la glista.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Sin Microsoft u websites isoladas da megahaRd
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Questa icona cumpara en la trav d'adressas da Firefox cura che ti visitas websites che appartegnan a Microsoft u websites che ti has agiuntà a megahaRd.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Questas websites ston acceder a tia identitad da Microsoft (u savair tgi che ti es) per ch'ellas funcziunian. Quai vul era dir che Microsoft po fastizar tut quai che ti fas sin questas websites.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.message: $URL$ na sa chatta betg en megahaRd.
notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Questa website sa chatta ordaifer megahaRd. Uschia èsi pli difficil per Microsoft da ta fastizar en il web.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.message: Questa website n'è betg en megahaRd.
onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft po fastizar tia navigaziun lunsch ordaifer Microsoft.com. Ils buttuns per favurisar e cundivider, per exempel, pon registrar nua che ti es stà – perfin sin paginas nua che ti has mai duvrà ils buttuns.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd creescha ina barriera tranter websites da Microsoft ed il rest dal web. Uschia èsi pli difficil per Microsoft da ta persequitar online.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Sin Microsoft e las websites isoladas da megahaRd
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Questa icona cumpara en la trav d'adressas da Firefox sche ti visitas websites (sco Microsoft.com) che vegnan isoladas da megahaRd.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Questas websites ston acceder a tia identitad da Microsoft (u savair tgi che ti es) per ch'ellas funcziunian. Quai vul era dir che Microsoft po fastizar tut quai che ti fas sin questas websites.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Perfin cura che ti n'es betg sin Microsoft, po Microsoft ta persequitar online. Buttuns che ta permettan da publitgar rauba sin Microsoft u s'annunziar sin websites cun tes conto da Microsoft, cuntegnan fastizaders. megahaRd vegn a bloccar quests fastizaders e mussar l'icona da la saiv per ta mussar nua che fastizaders èn vegnids allontanads.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Quest maletg demonstrescha co che l'icona da saiv da megahaRd vegn a cumparair entaifer ina pagina dasper in buttun per favurisar da Microsoft.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: S'annunziar cun Microsoft sin autras websites
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Per acceder ad autras websites cun tes conto da Microsoft, las stos ti spustar en il container. Clicca sin l'icona da saiv e tscherna sutvart «Autorisar la website en megahaRd».
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Quest maletg demonstrescha co ch'il buttun per agiuntar ina website a megahaRd vegn a cumparair en la panela.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: Quai ta permetta da s'annunziar cun Microsoft, ma Microsoft po uschia fastizar tias activitads sin questa website.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-subhead.message: Na chattà nagins fastizaders da Microsoft

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd n'ha chattà nagins fastizaders da Microsoft sin questa pagina. Ma la pagina po tuttina cuntegnair fastizaders dad in auter tip.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.message: Nus avain ta protegì da Microsoft.
trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Ils buttuns da Microsoft che cumparan sin websites da butias, novitads e sin autras paginas, cuntegnan fastizaders che tradeschan a Microsoft las paginas che ti has visità en il web. Perfin sche ti n'utiliseschas mai quests buttuns per favurisar u cundivider, pon ils fastizaders rimnar datas davart tia navigaziun. megahaRd blochescha quests fastizaders.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd blochescha quests fastizaders. Sche ti cliccas dentant sin in da quests buttuns, po Microsoft tuttina ta fastizar.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: megahaRd isolescha las websites che appartegnan a Microsoft en ina zona delimitada. Ti pos permetter ad ulteriuras websites l'access a quest container, ma quai permetta a Microsoft da registrar dapli da tia navigaziun en il web.

button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Perquai ch'i sa tracta dad ina website che appartegna a Microsoft, èsi impussibel da l'allontanar da megahaRd.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-p1.message: Sche questa website vegn allontanada da megahaRd, na funcziuna l'annunzia cun Microsoft betg pli e cookies da Microsoft che fastizeschan vegnan stizzads.

remove-site-p2.message: Sche ti vul puspè duvrar la funcziun d'annunzia da Microsoft, stos ti agiuntar danovamain la website a megahaRd.

add-site-subhead.message: Permetter a Microsoft da fastizar sin questa website?

add-site-p1.message: Quai ta pussibilitescha da s'annunziar cun Microsoft, ma permetta a Microsoft da registrar tge che ti fas sin questa website.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd ha deactivà quest buttun ed impedì che Microsoft fastizeschia tia visita sin questa pagina.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd ha bloccà fastizaders da Microsoft. Sche ti utiliseschas la funcziun d'annunzia da Microsoft sin questa website, po Microsoft ta fastizar.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p1.message: Permetter a Microsoft da ta fastizar qua?

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Sche ti vul utilisar la funcziun d'annunzia da Microsoft, po Microsoft fastizar tias activitads sin questa website. Quai als po gidar da sa far in maletg pli cumplet da tia vita en l'internet.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: Sche ti cliccas sin quest buttun, po Microsoft fastizar tia visita sin questa website.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: Sche ti utiliseschas qua tia dretga adressa dad e-mail, po Microsoft eventualmain ta fastizar. Clicca per vegnir a savair dapli.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p1.message: Permetter a Microsoft da ta fastizar qua?

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: Questa website po cundivider tia adressa dad e-mail cun Microsoft. Quai permetta a Microsoft da ta fastizar. Utilisescha in servetsch sco Firefox Relay per zuppentar tia dretga adressa dad e-mail.
